challenge_coverage.plot_local_condition_overrides: covered: TPS548C26 per-plot MODE/VCC rows vs page defaults (probes P1/P2); LMR33610 legend-temperature override of page TA default (recorded in conditions.legend_override)
challenge_coverage.linear_vs_log_axes: log10 tick-fit and log-space interpolation implemented and unit-tested synthetically; NO real logarithmic-axis reference in the vector-extractable corpus (TLS4125D0EPV raster, LT8292 not held) — open item
challenge_coverage.efficiency_vs_power_loss: covered: TPS548C26 figures 6-1..6-6 split into distinct phenomena (efficiency_vs_load vs power_dissipation_vs_load); probes P1 vs P8
challenge_coverage.multiple_traces_same_figure: covered: 4-trace fsw legends (TPS548C26, TPS628302), 3-trace temperature legends (LMR33610); unmatched trace colors skip with legend_unresolved (35 skips recorded)
challenge_coverage.cross_manufacturer_comparability: partial: TI vs Vishay evidence compared only through typed conditions; Vishay external-component legends (VIN=..V, L=..uH) are vector-text and unresolvable deterministically -> refused, recorded
challenge_coverage.typical_never_guaranteed: covered: evidence_class carried end-to-end, guarantee:false on every computed value, comparisons are status:proposal (tests test_r3_*, test_r4_*)
challenge_coverage.unmatched_plots_and_series_penalized: covered: scorer coverage metric (40/70 printed figures -> 0.571) plus per-miss listings; unmatched predictions counted as errors, never silently skipped

no_promotion_clause: Nothing in this manifest promotes machine references to gold. Human gold = the 14 hand-labeled MCU series (tests/fixtures/gold/typical_curves) + any packet a human signs in results/curve-review/signoff.json.
